{"id":190756,"tenderTitle":"T709-801GD DLT-BASED ACCESS MANAGEMENT FOR THE (CO-)OPERATION OF SHARED SPACE ASSETS (EXPRO+)","tenderNumber":"1-13588","tenderDescription":"There is an increasing trend towards collaboration among space agencies and a rapidly growingnumber of commercial space actors. This raises the scenario and challenge of how different partiescan cooperatively operate shared space assets through distributed access control mechanisms.The standard approach to manage access to a shared asset, e.g., hosted payloads, where one ofthe collaborating parties assumes full authority over the asset, while the other parties strictly rely onthis authority, may be too rigid for manyemerging use cases. Modern concepts such as launch rideshares, ground segments and platforms as a service models, or even token-based economiccommercialisation of space missions require a more fully collaborative approach.Thus, in the pursuit towards true collaboration and along trends such as web3 and Blockchain, thisactivity shall aim to demonstrate fully distributed identity and accessmanagement.
